BOOKS.title: De orbe novo decades
BOOKS.author: Pietro Martire d'Anghiera
BOOKS.note: Alcalá 1530, all eight Decades; the Ribera remark is Dec. V ch. 10, fol. 86. Our 1533 Basel copy stops at Dec. III.

BOOKS.title: Antiquities of Mexico, Vol. 3
BOOKS.author: Edward King, Viscount Kingsborough
BOOKS.note: Holds the Dresden Codex plates (Aglio); completes our Kingsborough set alongside vols 1, 2, 5, 7, 8.

BOOKS.title: Antiquities of Mexico, Vol. 6
BOOKS.author: Edward King, Viscount Kingsborough
BOOKS.note: Notes volume; p. 268 prints Martyr's Ribera passage in the old English.

BOOKS.title: Vues des cordillères, et monumens des peuples indigènes de l'Amérique, Tome 1
BOOKS.author: Alexander von Humboldt
BOOKS.note: Text volume; the Dresden plate 45 discussion is printed pp. 266-268. Plates volume is held (6aeb00fe19312ecd297aa315).

BOOKS.title: The Palenque Tablet in the United States National Museum, Washington, D.C.
BOOKS.author: Charles Rau
BOOKS.note: Smithsonian Contributions to Knowledge 331; Brinton's letter of 4 March 1879, pp. 52-53.

BOOKS.title: A Glimpse at Guatemala, and Some Notes on the Ancient Monuments of Central America
BOOKS.author: Anne Cary Maudslay and Alfred Percival Maudslay
BOOKS.note: p. 255: Landa's alphabet 'probably of a syllabic and not of an alphabetic character'.

BOOKS.title: Colección de documentos inéditos para la historia de España, Tomo I
BOOKS.author: Martín Fernández de Navarrete et al. (eds.)
BOOKS.note: The Veracruz inventory of 1519 with the Seville and Vienna variants, pp. 461-472; 'dos libros' on p. 469.
